lobes.contactQualification: Literal nominal copper intersects native via annulus/pad geometry; positive-area contact only. This is not a multi-layer MCU-VSS reach proof and does not include same-layer trace/fill-neighbor chains.

projectedValidInnerGroundPlanes.qualification: Projection only, not a cross-layer connection. A proposed plated via must actually contact this valid plane and pass all-layer clearance/drill/body checks.
